methods.name: pick
methods.doc: Open the host's OS chooser for a Remote caller.

methods.name: list
methods.doc: List one directory level for a Remote caller's in-app browser.

methods.name: createDirectory
methods.doc: Create one child directory for a Remote caller's in-app browser.

props.name: name
props.doc: Base name shown in a browser row (a root crumb carries its full path).

props.name: path
props.doc: Absolute host path — clients never join path segments themselves.

props.name: hidden
props.doc: Hidden by the host platform's convention (dot-prefixed on POSIX); the client owns whether to show it.

DirectoryEntry.doc: One directory row: a listing child or a breadcrumb ancestor.

props.name: path
props.doc: Absolute path of the listed directory.

props.name: home
props.doc: The host account's home directory (breadcrumb "Home" rooting).

props.name: crumbs
props.doc: Ancestor chain from the filesystem root to the listed directory inclusive; every crumb is a jump target (crumb `hidden` is always false).

props.name: entries
props.doc: Direct child directories, name-sorted; symlinks to directories included.

props.name: truncated
props.doc: True when the backend cut `entries` at its complete-result bound: the level has more child directories than reported, and the missing rows are the name-sorted tail (hidden rows count toward the bound).

DirectoryListing.doc: One directory level plus its ancestry, as a browse backend reports it.
